title: Complete the eight-quarter covenant forecast
prompt:
Edit this file in place:
`Shared/Finance/Treasury/Bank - covenants/FY27 covenant forecast - WORKING.xlsx`

We need the FY27 covenant outlook refreshed before the next bank discussion. Start with the July treasury correspondence, then work from the current controller-tied support, posted debt balances, and the executed credit documents. Earlier treasury files remain available for change history, so resolve any differences from the dates, approval status, and follow-up correspondence. Tie opening funded debt to the contractor-accounting records.

Preserve `Forecast Inputs` and `Debt Schedule`. Complete `Covenant Forecast`, `Downside`, and `Checks` for the eight forecast quarters. Show the funded-debt roll-forward, trailing-period covenant calculations, headroom, first breach, and any cure amount under the controlling agreement for both the approved case and the documented downside.

Document the controlling sources and model status in the workbook. Recalculate the saved file and leave no spreadsheet errors or temporary files.

Save the finished workbook to the exact target path.
